title: Tell HN: Danny Cohen Has Died
guide_zh: 帖子通报互联网协议先驱 Danny Cohen 去世，追忆其技术贡献。
author: drallison
excerpt: Danny Cohen died yesterday morning, August 12th, peacefully at home. Danny was major figure in the development of Internet protocols, particularly those related to packet audio and video. He was a member of the Internet Hall of Fame ( https://www.internethalloffame.org/inductees/danny-cohen ).
